Problem Statement
A social networking platform stores friendships as connections between users. Given the friendship pairs, determine the total number of connections in the graph.
Description
The first line contains the number of users N and the number of friendships E. The next E lines contain pairs of connected users. Print the total number of edges.
Sample Input
5 4
0 1
1 2
2 3
3 4
